prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept. Draw an animation contact sheet for Myo-ryung.
Reference 1 defines the rabbit woman's identity. Reference 2 defines Ja-Hyun's proportions, which must be transferred to her.
Target: Myo-ryung, adult feminine rabbit-themed human fighter. Silver-white hair with rose ribbons; exactly two very long white rabbit ears with pink inside, bent naturally to the sides; human face and hands/legs; white and warm pink sporty cropped jacket and top, pleated layer over fitted shorts, white knee socks with pink bands, oversized white/pink high-top sneakers. Keep original rose accessories. One small round white tail is permitted only if visible in side/rear view, never a long tail. Kick-ready fighting guard, grounded idle.
Draw EXACTLY SIXTEEN FULL-BODY small figures in FOUR ROWS and FOUR COLUMNS. All sixteen wear identical clothing, have the same head size, same torso/limb lengths, face right, and stand on both feet in a low balanced human guard like Ja-Hyun. Vary the subtle breathing, weight transfer, arm guard, ears and ribbons across all sixteen poses as a looping idle animation.
Match Ja-Hyun's anatomical proportions, roughly three heads tall excluding ears. Give her a clear torso and substantial bent thighs/shins. Keep her adult feminine face. Keep each figure within the CENTER 65% of its cell with broad empty gutters, including a wide lower margin below the bottom row's shoes. Every figure must be complete and fully drawn, especially row four. No clipping, no touching figures, no shrinking later rows. Clean polished NON-PIXEL semi-dimensional chibi game art.
BACKGROUND: one completely uniform matte medium gray, RGB(128,128,128), opaque. This is an intermediate source for later background extraction. No alpha transparency simulation, no checkerboard, no texture, no gradient, no shadow, no VFX, no colored edge halos, no loose dots. No text, labels, grid, watermark, brand or opponent.
